description: CM5 estimates major contributions to the near-Earth magnetic field through an inverse model. Satellite and ground measurements support separation of internal, ionospheric and magnetospheric field sources. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Geospace; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Its documented calibration uses pre-Swarm observations from a historical period. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
